messages:
rachel_cs: FYI we hit a snag on Solasta renewal. Buyer uploaded PO but it's missing the legal entity name and they insist subsidiary signs before parent. AP won't pay without entity match. :grimacing:
dan_sales: They want a 6-month term on the subsidiary portion and annual for the rest. Are we ok with split-term billing?
helen_finance: We can do split-term invoices, but our system needs the legal entity to generate tax lines. Without that, VAT/tax fields will be blank and AP will reject.
marco_legal: Can procure provide a corrected PO? If they refuse, we can add a short amendment capturing entity mapping and the split-term structure. That would allow invoice generation.
rachel_cs: Buyer (quoted): "Subsidiary signs first. Our procurement team requires the local legal name on the invoice PDF and then parent will sign."
onboarding-bot: Training hold: Solasta onboarding slot reserved for 2026-07-12 09:00. Will auto-release in 72h if invoice not available.
billing-bot: New PO uploaded: SOL-PO-449 (amount EUR 48,000)  missing: legal_entity_name field.
helen_finance: Quick workaround: legal adds an Annex listing the subsidiary legal name and the invoice reference line. Finance can then issue a consolidated invoice PDF referencing both entities and the split-term lines. Treasury ok with parent wiring if annex present.
marco_legal: I'll draft Annex A stating: "Supplier may reference Subsidiary [Solasta GmbH] and Parent [Solasta Holdings Ltd.] on invoices; invoicing split per schedule attached." Will set signing order: 1) Subsidiary CFO, 2) Parent Procurement, 3) Redwood.
dan_sales: I'll ask buyer for written confirmation that parent treasury accepts consolidated invoice and annex.
rachel_cs: Customer confirmed in chat: "We accept a single PDF referencing both entities and will wire from parent as long as Annex A is signed."
helen_finance: OK—finance will accept consolidated PDF with two invoice reference lines. Please ensure Annex A is on the signed PDF.
marco_legal: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example.com/envelopes/solasta-449-amend (sign order set).
onboarding-bot: Once signed PDF available, free the training slot and send kickoff calendar invite.
rachel_cs: Action items: Marco draft/upload Annex, Dan confirm buyer email, Helen prep consolidated invoice template, I'll hold onboarding loosely until signed PDF. Everyone good?
all: :thumbsup:
(END)
